#compdef jet
# zsh completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions zsh`)
_jet() {
local -a commands flags
commands=(
        'registry:Publish and manage packages'
        'inspect:Explore code, builds, packages, and bindings'
        'hangar:Inspect and maintain the package store'
        'project:Inspect project files and modules'
        'self:Manage the Jet installation and editor tools'
        'diff:Compare two Jet programs by meaning'
        'merge:Merge Jet programs without losing code structure'
        'review:Review meaning, authority, and proof changes'
        'run:Run a program or project'
        'jobs:List project #Job functions (<file.jet> -- <job>)'
        'check:Check code without creating a binary'
        'fill:Propose checked code for typed goals'
        'test:Run tests'
        'prove:Create a proof report for code and tests'
        'status:Show what the project has proved'
        'build:Create a native executable'
        'dev:Watch and run a program; optionally open the Canvas IDE'
        'try:Speculatively apply a plan and re-check its claims'
        'debug:Debug a program from Jet source'
        'repl:Try Jet code interactively'
        'notebook:Open a Jet notebook (.jetnb) or Jupyter adapter'
        'import:Convert supported source code into editable Jet'
        'new:Create a Jet project'
        'fmt:Format Jet and configured project files'
        'fix:Apply safe automatic fixes, including `fix memory`'
        'audit:Inspect implicit copies, exercised memory witnesses, or dependencies'
        'lint:Run optional code-quality checks'
        'explain:Explain a diagnostic code, build fact, or generic-module value'
        'env:Open the project development shell'
        'shared-store:Manage the optional shared Hangar broker'
        'cache:Manage host-owned binary-cache bindings'
        'remote:Manage host-owned remote builders'
        'trust:Review or change trusted authority'
        'image:Build a declared container image'
        'os:Manage Jetos machines and images'
        'add:Add and download a dependency'
        'remove:Remove a dependency'
        'fetch:Download locked dependencies'
        'search:Search the local package catalog'
        'find:Find code by type, effect, or example'
        'update:Update dependency or toolchain pins'
        'init:Create package settings in this directory'
        'split:Extract closed Package facts into Configs or members'
        'fold:Reverse a recorded Package source transition'
        'gc:Show values moved into automatic memory management'
        'clean:Remove unused package-store data'
        'emit:Print generated build output'
        'eval:Evaluate pure Jet and print the value (`--json` for JSON)'
        'budget:Check performance limits or update baselines'
        'perf:Collect and inspect performance traces'
        'report:Write a private local report bundle'
        'fuzz:Find failing inputs for property tests'
        'version:Show the Jet version'
        'help:Show command help'
    )
flags=(
        '--attach[with inspect live\: process id to observe]'
        '--once[with inspect live\: print one snapshot and exit]'
        '--observe[with run\: expose bounded live runtime facts for attachment]'
        '--raw-frames[with debug\: show generated Rust frames and scopes (expert)]'
        '--dap[with debug\: speak the Debug Adapter Protocol over stdio]'
        '--gc-trace[with run/dev\: record bounded automatic GC-promotion evidence]'
        '--structural[with diff/merge\: compare checked definitions by semantic identity]'
        '--base-receipt[with review\: proof receipt for the base change-set side]'
        '--receipt[with review\: proof receipt for the reviewed change-set side]'
        '--out[with structural merge\: write the checked result to this path]'
        '--repo[with merge install-driver\: Git worktree to configure]'
        '--json[emit machine-readable facts or diagnostics]'
        '--topic[with inspect digest\: emit one digest topic]'
        '--list-topics[with inspect digest\: list digest topics]'
        '--kind[with inspect gates/authority\: filter one gate kind]'
        '--quiet[suppress non-error status output]'
        '--color[color\: auto | always | never]'
        '--version[print compiler version]'
        '--check[with fmt\: exit 1 if any file would change (CI gate)]'
        '--lang[with fmt\: delegate non-Jet files to the environment formatter for this language]'
        '--restore-role-files[with init\: restore the exact pre-package.jet role files]'
        '--diff[with fmt --check\: also print unified diffs for each changed file]'
        '--simplify[with fmt\: rewrite to the simplest ratified spelling]'
        '--changed[with fmt\: format only VCS-changed .jet files (requires git)]'
        '--explicit-copies[with fmt\: materialize implicit read-view copies as `~`]'
        '--skipped[with project parts\: show modules omitted from automatic discovery]'
        '--stdin-path[with fmt -\: path label used in diagnostics when reading from stdin]'
        '--small[with build/run\: favor a smaller binary]'
        '--lib[with build\: emit the native Library and C header]'
        '--output[with run/dev\: select a named build output (Canvas uses it as the initial selection)]'
        '--locked[with fetch\: verify only, refuse network]'
        '--effect[with find\: require an effect such as FS.Read]'
        '--example[with find\: search by input/output example]'
        '--lock[with fetch\: lock a manifest-less script'\''s inline deps instead of fetching a project]'
        '--read-only[with shared-store enroll\: grant read-only broker access]'
        '--fd[with shared-store broker\: inherited broker socket descriptor]'
        '-p[with run/dev/debug/check/build/jobs\: pick a workspace member by name]'
        '--annotated[with new\: include commented example deps]'
        '--force[with publish\: bypass pre-publish gate (with warning)]'
        '--no-sign[with publish\: skip the optional author signature (registry metadata is still signed)]'
        '--registry[with keygen/key\: registry name to generate or manage a signing key for]'
        '--pkg[with bind\: library name for the generated binding module]'
        '--clang[with bind cpp\: path to the clang binary used to parse the header]'
        '--ar[with bind cpp\: path to the ar archiver used to build the static library]'
        '--from[with hangar repair\: signed archive to repair the entry from]'
        '--to[with hangar copy/export/sign\: destination Hangar root, archive, or signature path]'
        '--message[with yank\: human-readable reason for yanking the version]'
        '--before[with schema squash\: re-baseline migrations before this version]'
        '--spdx[with sbom\: emit SPDX tag-value format (default)]'
        '--cyclonedx[with sbom\: emit CycloneDX JSON format]'
        '--advisory-db[with audit\: path to advisory database file]'
        '--vendor-dir[with vendor\: directory to copy dependencies into (default vendor/)]'
        '--sbom[with build\: also write an SPDX SBOM next to the binary]'
        '--verbose[with build\: print the bridge steps]'
        '--online[with doctor\: allow network checks]'
        '--fix[with doctor\: apply auto-fixable problems]'
        '--dry-run[with rewrite commands\: preview changes without writing]'
        '--keep[with try\: keep a clean speculative edit]'
        '--edition[with fix\: apply edition migration rewrites --edition=<year>]'
        '--all[with fix\: apply safety classes beyond formatting and behavior-preserving]'
        '--try-anyway[with dev\: interpret past unsupported features (no guarantees)]'
        '--interpret[with dev\: force the tier-0 TIR interpreter]'
        '--trace-tiers[with run/dev\: print per-function Cranelift vs interpreter tier selection; with test\: print AOT marker]'
        '--restart[with dev\: always rerun from scratch after a save]'
        '--swap[with dev\: hot-swap compatible edits and restart after type changes]'
        '--watch[with run/dev\: re-run on dependency changes; --watch=off runs once]'
        '--canvas[with dev\: open the full Canvas IDE over this dev session]'
        '--canvas-host[with dev\: with --canvas, bind host (loopback by default)]'
        '--canvas-port[with dev\: with --canvas, bind an explicit port]'
        '--canvas-transport[with dev\: with --canvas, select the named transport]'
        '--canvas-authority[with dev\: with --canvas, select loopback or remote authority]'
        '--canvas-audit[with dev\: with --canvas, enable request/rebuild audit output]'
        '--project[with repl\: load package settings and imports from this directory]'
        '--protocol[with notebook\: use the bounded headless JSONL/script session]'
        '--headless[with notebook\: use the bounded headless session]'
        '--bind[with notebook\: bind the local HTTP client to this address]'
        '--token[with notebook\: require this bearer token for clients]'
        '--pure[with eval\: reject code with side effects]'
        '--freestanding[with build/run\: target a system without an operating system]'
        '--gate[with build/run/dev\: allow one audited gate as --gate name=allow]'
        '--target[with build/run/dev\: select a target\: a rustc triple or board.<name>]'
        '--env[with env/run/dev/test\: select one declared env.<name> module]'
        '--preset[with env/run/dev/test\: select one declared environment preset]'
        '--explain-partition[with build --target=web\: show which code becomes JavaScript or WebAssembly]'
        '--update-snapshots[with test\: replace expected snapshot output]'
        '--coverage[with test\: show function and branch coverage]'
        '--rust[with emit\: print generated Rust source]'
        '--emit-generated[with build\: copy generated Jet sources into build/generated/]'
        '-u[short form of --update-snapshots]'
        '--release[with build/run/test\: optimize for release]'
        '--profile[with build/run\: how hard to optimize\: release, debug, ci, or a named optimization bundle]'
        '--set[with build/run\: set one declared package setting as key=value]'
        '--builder[with build\: select a previously bound remote builder]'
        '--a11y[with lint\: check roles, labels, and other accessibility basics]'
        '--complexity[with lint\: report per-function cognitive complexity]'
        '--max[with lint --complexity\: fail when a function exceeds this score]'
        '--scope[with inspect gates/authority or trust grant\: choose a ledger or trust scope]'
        '--filter[with test\: only run claims whose name contains --filter=<substr>]'
        '--shuffle[with test\: run tests in random (or --shuffle=<seed>) order]'
        '--serial[with test\: run tests one at a time instead of the parallel default]'
        '--show-default[with run/build/dev/test\: use and report the stock default]'
        '--measure[with test\: measure `.measure` claims]'
        '--record[with run/dev/test\: record a named replay as --record=<name>]'
        '--replay[with debug\: consume a named replay as --replay=<name>]'
        '--iterations[with fuzz\: case budget --iterations=<n> (default 1000)]'
        '--time[with fuzz\: wall-clock budget in seconds --time=<n>]'
        '--seed[with fuzz\: base PRNG seed --seed=<n> (default\: fixed, reproducible)]'
        '--corpus[with fuzz\: corpus directory --corpus=<dir> (default\: .jet/fuzz/<test>)]'
        '--lens[with prove\: project the human report by an exact evidence facet]'
	'--facts[with expand\: project inline, memory, web, effects, layout, origin, derive, templates, or callable-signature facts --facts=<lens>]'
        '--annotations[with budget\: CI annotations auto, none, or github]'
        '--baseline[with budget update\: selected baseline name]'
        '--bootstrap[with budget update\: create absent or stale baseline history]'
        '--accept-regression[with budget update\: explicitly accept a regression]'
        '--reason[with exceptional budget update\: checked-in reason]'
        '--yes[with budget update\: apply a valid non-interactive plan]'
        '-y[short form of --yes]'
        '--allow-net[with build\: allow Net access for this run]'
        '--deny-net[with repl\: deny Net access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-fs[with build\: allow FS access for this run]'
        '--deny-fs[with repl\: deny FS access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-io[with build\: allow IO access for this run]'
        '--deny-io[with repl\: deny IO access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-db[with build\: allow DB access for this run]'
        '--deny-db[with repl\: deny DB access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-time[with build\: allow Time access for this run]'
        '--deny-time[with repl\: deny Time access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-rand[with build\: allow Rand access for this run]'
        '--deny-rand[with repl\: deny Rand access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-env[with build\: allow Env access for this run]'
        '--deny-env[with repl\: deny Env access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-exec[with build\: allow Exec access for this run]'
        '--deny-exec[with repl\: deny Exec access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-log[with build\: allow Log access for this run]'
        '--deny-log[with repl\: deny Log access; overrides allow and prompts]'
        '--allow-gpu[with build\: allow GPU access for this run]'
        '--deny-gpu[with repl\: deny GPU access; overrides allow and prompts]'
    )
if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
_describe -t commands 'command' commands
elif (( CURRENT == 3 )); then
case $words[2] in
            registry) _values 'action' 'publish:Publish the current package' 'yank:Stop new installs of a published version' 'keygen:Create a package-signing key' 'key:Manage the package-signing key' 'vendor:Copy dependencies into vendor/' ;;
            inspect) _values 'action' 'live:Watch a running Jet process' 'graph:Show the build graph' 'query:Search code and build information' 'explain-build:Explain why a target, action, or file is rebuilt' 'compiler:Read compiler facts as versioned JSON' 'impact:Show code affected by a symbol' 'dossier:Show everything known about a file or symbol' 'guarantees:Show memory-safety guarantees by component' 'provenance:Read dependency provenance' 'digest:Write the one-file LLM surface digest' 'env:List typed environment reads in a config surface' 'semindex:Search the code index' 'expand:Show expanded meaning of Jet code (use --json for canonical facts)' 'unsafe:Review unsafe code and its safeguards' 'gates:Read the complete compile-time gate ledger' 'authority:Read rights-bearing gates from the ledger' 'schema:Inspect saved data schema versions' 'codemod:Preview or apply code changes' 'audit:Inspect implicit copies, exercised memory witnesses, or dependencies' 'sbom:Create a software bill of materials' 'bind:Generate Jet bindings from a foreign header' 'logs:Show recent package build logs' 'info:Show package details' 'outdated:List dependencies with available updates' 'reserved:List reserved words and sigils' 'facts:List every registered truth and its guard' 'structure:Inspect liveness, lifecycle, and import-edge facts' ;;
            hangar) _values 'action' 'path:Show the resolved user Hangar path' 'verify:Check package-store integrity' 'repair:Repair a damaged Hangar object from a signed archive' 'copy:Copy a verified closure between local Hangars' 'import:Verify and import a signed Hangar archive' 'export:Export a signed Hangar closure' 'dump:Stream a signed Hangar archive' 'restore:Restore a signed Hangar archive from stdin' 'sign:Sign a Hangar object or archive' 'recover:Recover Hangar staging, build scratch, and leases' 'rollback:Restore an earlier package-store generation' 'generations:List package-store generations' 'du:Show Hangar disk use per root or across the machine' ;;
            project) _values 'action' 'parts:List loaded and skipped project modules' ;;
            self) _values 'action' 'toolchain:Show the Jet version selected for this project' 'upgrade:Show how to install a newer Jet release' 'doctor:Find and fix toolchain problems' 'completions:Print shell completions' 'man:Print the Jet manual' 'devtools:Run Jet maintenance tools' 'lsp:Start the language server' 'exec:Execute one command in an authority-bound workspace' ;;
            env) _values 'action' 'test:Run environment checks in a clean environment' 'hook:Print the shell auto-activation hook' 'sync:Apply typed managed environment files' 'info:Show the typed environment plan' ;;
            shared-store) _values 'action' 'install:Install the optional shared Hangar broker' 'enroll:Grant a user shared-store broker access' 'status:Show shared-store broker configuration' 'broker:Serve one shared-store broker request' ;;
            os) _values 'action' 'push:Deploy one or more Jetos machines' 'bridge:Convert an existing system configuration to Jet' 'services:Manage development services' 'config:Manage Jet settings and trust' ;;
            gc) _values 'action' 'report:Show values moved into automatic memory management' ;;
            perf) _values 'action' 'run:Run a program and write a .jettrace' 'test:Run tests and write a .jettrace' 'attach:Attach to a running process and write a .jettrace' 'view:Show a .jettrace summary' 'compare:Compare two .jettrace artifacts' 'export:Export a loss-declared projection of a .jettrace' ;;
        esac
else
_values 'flag' $flags
_files
fi
}
_jet "$@"
